evidence: Nestled in the heart of Hanoi, the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology stands as a vibrant hub of cultural activity, its sprawling grounds serving as a living museum that brings to life the rich tapestry of Vietnamese traditions. The museum’s vast, flat rammed earth courtyard, painted in the rustic golden hue of bamboo poles, is a testament to the enduring legacy of the thousand-year-old wet-rice civilization.
